jobs.description:
Understanding exactly what a customer needs is essential. Do you believe listening is just as important as speaking? Then keep reading!
 

A selection of your responsibilities:
 

 
• You respond to customer enquiries by telephone and email, identify customers' needs and provide clear, helpful and professional support.
 
• You ensure a smooth and accurate order flow, from receiving orders to invoicing.
 
• You create, update and maintain customer accounts and ensure that customer information is complete and accurate.
 
• You support customers with webshop enquiries, online ordering, account access and other website-related issues.
 
• You assist with the day-to-day aministration of online webshops, including order follow-up, customer questions and issue resolution.
 
• You register and handle returns, claims and complaints in a timely manner and propose ways to prevent recurring issues.
 
• You maintain up-to-date knowledge of products, prices, promotions, procedures and online information to resolve customer questions effectively.
 
• You mainly support B2C customers, while also assisting professional customers such as retailers and wholesalers with orders, service requests and online tools. 

We are looking for the following profile:
 

 
• You are a native English speaker with excellent spoken and written communication skills.
 
• You are customer-focused, empathetic, flexible and a strong communicator.
 
• You are confident handling a high volume of telephone calls and emails while maintaining accuracy and service quality.
 
• You are comfortable using webshops, online platforms, Microsoft Office and customer or order-management systems.
 
• You can set priorities, organize your work and follow customer requests through to completion.
 
• You are enthusiastic, eager to learn and enjoy working as part of a team.
 
• You are comfortable with routine administrative tastks and maintain a positive approach in every customer interaction.
 
• You have a commercial mindset and know how to combine customer focus with result-oriented working.
 
• You are available for a full-time position.

What do you have to do?
 

 
• As a production line operator, you set up the machine according to the correct parameters and make adjustments as needed.
 
• You inspect the quality of the finished products.
 
• You supply raw materials and packaging materials to the production line.
 
• Your responsibilities will also include changing machine setups, as well as cleaning and maintaining the production line. 

Who are you?
 

 
• You are willing to work in the food industry
 
• You adhere to hygiene and safety standards
 
• You have your own transportation
 
• You have a good to very good knowledge of Dutch or English
 
• You are able to work in a two-shift system (5am-1pm and 1pm-9pm)
 
• You are willing to complete in-house training
 
• You have a truly hands-on attitude
 
• You are a team player

What will you have to do?
 

 
• Learn how to prepare our extensive range of chocolates
 
• You’ll learn the recipes so you can perform all tasks independently
 
• You’ll keep your workstation tidy, because that’s how you prefer to work
 
• As a line operator, you’ll set up the machine according to the correct parameters and adjust them as needed.
 
• You inspect the quality of the finished products.
 
• You supply the raw materials and packaging materials to the production line.
 
• Converting machines is also part of your responsibilities, as is cleaning and maintaining the production line. 

Who are you?
 

 
• You have a degree as a chocolatier, baker, or pastry chef OR possess the necessary experience
 
• Recent graduates in the fields of chocolatier, baker, or pastry chef are also welcome
 
• You are able to work in a two-shift system (5:00 AM–1:00 PM / 1:00 PM–9:00 PM)
 
• You adhere to hygiene and safety standards
 
• You have your own transportation
 
• You have a good to very good knowledge of Dutch or English
 
• You are willing to undergo in-house training
 
• You have a truly hands-on attitude
 
• You are a team player

Enjoy the freedom to take ownership, the support of a close-knit technical team and the opportunity to make a real impact.

Our partner is a Belgian Scale-Up company delivering advanced IT and infrastructure solutions to professional customers across various industries.

With a strong focus on innovation, connectivity and operational excellence, the company offers an environment where technical expertise is valued, ideas are encouraged and collaboration is part of everyday life.
Network Manager - Your Role
• Deploy network solutions:Design and implement wired, wireless and security infrastructures tailored to customer environments.
• Manage technical projects:Coordinate network integration activities from preparation and configuration through to deployment.
• Configure infrastructure:Work hands-on with switches, enterprise Wi-Fi, firewalls, VPNs and routing technologies.
• Strengthen network security:Implement NAC, authentication mechanisms, access policies and network segmentation.
• Solve technical challenges:Troubleshoot, monitor and optimize customer networks, ensuring reliability and performance.
• Collaborate with customers and colleagues:Provide technical guidance, document solutions and support deployments both on-site and internally.
 

Network Manager - Your Profile
• 5+ years of experiencein network engineering, infrastructure or network security.
• Strong practical knowledge ofswitching, routing, wireless networking and firewalls.
• Experience withExtreme Networks or Cisco Merakiis highly appreciated.
• Knowledge ofNAC solutions(ExtremeControl, Aruba ClearPass, Cisco ISE), 802.1X, RADIUS and network access security is a strong plus.
• A Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science or Telecommunications, or equivalent experience.
• Fluent inDutch (B2 minimum) and English, with basic French being an advantage. You are independent, service-oriented, analytical and a genuine team player.

Responsibilities

• Provide second-line support for internal applications and hardware to resolve complex IT incidents.
• Monitor incidents and proactively detect potential issues to ensure service continuity.
• Collaborate with other operations teams to ensure quick and efficient service restoration.
• Manage hardware and software requests throughout their lifecycle, including smartphones and laptops.
• Draft and maintain technical procedures within the ServiceNow Knowledge Base.
• Deliver external support by updating manuals and providing technical explanations to users.
• Support and guide new colleagues to ensure smooth team integration.

Requirements

• You possess a Bachelor’s degree in IT or an equivalent recognized qualification.
• 1+ years experience in 2nd line IT support within a professional environment.
• 1+ years experience with Windows 11 and Office 365.
• 1+ years experience managing Active Directory and SAP IDM.
• 1+ years experience with the rollout and lifecycle management of smartphones, laptops, tablets, and docking stations.
• Proven experience with network printer installation, troubleshooting, and driver management.
• Familiarity with ITIL processes and methodologies.
• Customer-oriented with strong analytical skills and a proactive mindset.
• You are native in Dutch with B2 level of French and C1 level of English.
Nice to Haves

• Knowledge of meeting room systems such as Evoko or Logitech.
• Scripting skills using PowerShell.
• Experience in writing technical documentation and user manuals.

Who are we?  

In today's digital world, prevention alone is no longer enough. Organisations need strong detection and response capabilities to identify and address threats quickly. That is where we come in. From Belgium and the Netherlands, we help organisations further develop their security capabilities. Our clients are among the top 200 companies in the Benelux and are active in a wide range of sectors. At Davinsi Labs, we collaborate closely, share knowledge and build an environment where expertise, initiative and growth are central.  

Your mission  

You will be part of our Managed Detection and Response organisation and work within the Microsoft Sentinel team. As a Microsoft Sentinel Security Engineer, you build and improve the technical capabilities on which our security services run. Your focus is not only on managing Sentinel, but above all on developing scalable, automated and reusable solutions for multiple client environments. You work at the intersection of security engineering, Azure, automation, detection engineering and AI. You develop new platform features, automate onboarding and configuration, build integrations and ensure that our Sentinel environments can be managed reliably and efficiently.  

Responsibilities  

You build and improve our Microsoft Sentinel platform capabilities and help shape how we can further standardise and automate our managed service. Among other things, you work on onboarding new clients, data integrations, deployment of security content, health monitoring and automation of operational processes. In addition, you develop new AI capabilities within our security service. You explore how AI can be used to accelerate detection engineering, make threat hunting smarter, better enrich threat intelligence and support security analysts in investigation and decision-making. You build proofs of concept and help turn successful ideas into robust, secure and reusable platform functionalities. You work with Git, CI/CD, scripting and APIs to manage configurations, security content and automation as code as much as possible. You work closely with detection engineers and SOC analysts and ensure that the platform offers them the right capabilities for detection, investigation and response.  

Your profile

You have experience as a Security Engineer, Cloud Security Engineer, SIEM Engineer or in a comparable technical role. You have knowledge of Microsoft Sentinel or a comparable SIEM platform and feel comfortable working within Microsoft Azure. You are interested in automation, development and AI, and enjoy experimenting with new technologies that can improve security processes. You have experience with scripting, APIs, Git or CI/CD. Knowledge of KQL, Microsoft Defender XDR, Entra ID, Infrastructure as Code or AI/LLM integrations is a strong asset. You like to think beyond a single configuration or client and look for structural solutions that are scalable and reusable. You communicate fluently in Dutch and English, enjoy working in a team and have an analytical, solution-oriented mindset.

Responsibilities

• Manage and optimize automated customer journeys and flows within ActiveCampaign.
• Translate business requirements into functional technical solutions for website and marketing automation projects.
• Coordinate with external technical partners and IT departments to evaluate and challenge technical proposals.
• Monitor website performance using Clarity to provide data-driven recommendations for user experience improvements.
• Support and train end-users on digital platforms to foster adoption of new functionalities and processes.
• Maintain the product roadmap and prioritize the backlog within an Agile development environment.

Requirements

• You possess 3+ years of experience as a Product Owner developing product visions and roadmaps while managing Product Backlogs.
• You bring 3+ years of expertise in marketing automation, specifically designing and optimizing automated customer journeys using ActiveCampaign.
• You have 3+ years of experience managing websites and CMS platforms, with a strong preference for Drupal.
• You're experienced with CRM integrations, APIs, and digital ecosystem connectivity.
• You possess a professional certification as a Product Owner or Product Manager within Agile methodologies.
• You have experience using Clarity or similar heatmap tools to analyze user behavior.
• You bring experience in training, demonstrating, and guiding end-users through the implementation of digital tools.
• You're skilled at analyzing requirements, assessing project impact, and managing project facets such as costs and timing.
• You are proactive, solution-oriented, and excel at building bridges between business and IT.
• You are native in Dutch with professional knowledge of English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and Looker Studio.
• Knowledge of Search Console, SiteImprove, and SEO/GEO principles.
• Willingness to apply knowledge of web accessibility standards.

You’ve worked registry-side or registrar-side. Here, the registration platform is the product, and you own its roadmap.

Product Owner | Domain Registration Platform | Brussels area

Our client is a European not-for-profit organisation, human-sized and firmly technology-driven, that manages and operates one of the world’s largest country-code top-level domains in the public interest.

What makes it stand out? It never sells to end users. Everything runs through a network of accredited registrars, so the EPP interface, the registration APIs and the lifecycle rules are the product, and the people on the other side of them are hosting providers and registrars across Europe.

That platform is now being modernised, moving from a legacy core towards the next generation of registration services, without a single interruption to a service registrars depend on every day.

The organisation is therefore looking for a Product Owner who already comes from this ecosystem — registry, registrar, hosting or registry back-end — and can hold a credible technical conversation with registrars from the first weeks.

All of this from offices in the Brussels area, within a multicultural team that works in English.

The job

• Own the vision, roadmap and backlog of the registration platform and of the domain-name lifecycle capabilities built on top of it.
• Translate registrar needs, operational realities and regulatory obligations into clear product direction, and make transparent trade-offs between value, urgency, risk and delivery capacity.Role
• Define and maintain the roadmap across the core registration platform, EPP, registration APIs, RDAP, domain-name lifecycle and data analytics capabilities.
• Own and structure the backlog, balancing immediate service improvements against modernisation, resilience and long-term sustainability.
• Act as the product counterpart for the accredited registrar channel: understand how they integrate, what breaks for them and what they need next.
• Give clear product direction to the Business Analysts, validate functional requirements and acceptance criteria, and own functional acceptance through to go/no-go release decisions.
• Ensure compliance with GDPR, NIS2 and internal governance frameworks, and follow developments within ICANN, IETF and CENTR.
Profile
• University degree in computer science, engineering, business, information systems or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
• 7+ years in technology-driven products or services, with real ownership as a Product Owner or Product Manager.
• Hands-on experience in the domain-name ecosystem is required, from either side of the Registry-Registrar-Registrant model: a ccTLD or gTLD registry, a registry back-end provider, a registrar or a hosting provider. Concretely, you have worked with EPP, WHOIS/RDAP, DNS provisioning, domain lifecycle processes or registry-to-registrar integrations. Candidates without exposure to this ecosystem cannot be considered.
• Based in Belgium, with excellent written and spoken English; other European languages are an asset.

Responsibilities

• Coach and guide multiple development teams in daily practices such as pair programming, mob programming, and joint refactoring.
• Advise teams on testing strategies including TDD, unit, integration, and contract testing within CI/CD pipelines.
• Facilitate the adoption of Trunk-Based Development and modern source control workflows to replace traditional merge request models.
• Guide architectural design decisions and foster a common technical culture across the organization.
• Identify and resolve bottlenecks in the developer experience, focusing on build times, pipeline reliability, and deployment processes.
• Implement a structured improvement cycle to identify, test, and measure the impact of technical enhancements.

Requirements

• 8+ years of experience in designing maintainable software using Java 21, DDD, Clean Architecture, and Hexagonal Architecture.
• 8+ years implementing engineering practices including TDD, Trunk-Based Development, and GitLab CI.
• 8+ years defining automated testing strategies across unit, integration, and contract levels as executable documentation.
• 5+ years facilitating Mob programming, Ensemble programming, and Software Teaming.
• 5+ years coaching developers and teams on complex problems to foster technical autonomy.
• 5+ years of experience working within a LeSS (Large-Scale Scrum) framework.
• You possess strong leadership skills with the ability to influence others without hierarchical authority.
• You bring a proactive approach to change management and are comfortable giving and receiving constructive feedback.
• You are fluent in Dutch and French with a professional level of English.
Nice to Haves

• Willingness to integrate AI tools to accelerate knowledge sharing and productivity.

  The incumbent is responsible for the processes on archiving completeness and transport document compliance for documents related to Global Logistics shipments. The incumbent drives process automation and process outsourcing to ensure timely and correct execution of compliance and completeness checks of transport documents. 
 
  The incumbent orchestrates and coordinates activities with relevant internal and external stakeholders to recover missing documentation and/or correct any issues identified. Stakeholder forums are set up and driven by the incumbent to focus on issue resolution and Continuous Improvement in the space of archiving completeness and documentation compliance. Leveraging digital tools and new technologies are focus areas.

•   Maintains and reports on performance metrics

•   Designs and orchestrates the process for conducting compliance checks of transport documents    
•   Ensures alignment of archiving process scope with evolving GL scope and Quality compliance requirements

•   Coordinates escalations and provides resolution to challenges escalated following the IMEX and Six Sigma methodologies    
•   Drives the conversation with Digital on the performance and enhancements of the App supporting the transport document compliance checks process and leveraging new technologies (e.g. AI)    
•   Orchestrates actions and assures accountability of internal and external stakeholders to ensure completeness and full compliance    
•   Maintains and reports on performance metrics    
  3) Stakeholder Management 
   
•   Sets up, participates and drives stakeholder conver...

  QUALIFICATIONS 
   
•   Level of Education: Bachelor's Degree in Administration, university degree or equivalent by experience    
•   Experience: Minimum 5 years experience in transport or supply chain operations. Comprehension of financial and logistics flows inherent to the pharma industry. Knowledge on customs regulations would be a plus.    
•   Languages: Proficient in English (verbal and written); other languages are a benefit    
•   Computer skills: Broad PC skills are essential (MS applications Outlook, Word, Excel, Visio and PowerPoint). Knowledge of SAP or other ERP systems is a plus.    
  COMPETENCIES – PERSONAL CAPABILITIES 
   
•   Analytical and problem solving skills    
•   Pro-active mindset on problem solving and gap assessment    
•   Affinity with establishing structure, documentation management and compliance principles    
•   Proven track record driving positive change in a complex environment    
•   Demonstrate strong problem-solving skills based on facts, data and understanding of the regulatory requirement in complex and evolving environments; must be able to apply sound risk management    
•   Ability to prioritize, quickly synthesize information and apply regulatory requirements to a variety of scenarios    
•   Must exercise excellent judgement, make decisions based on a clear understanding of the regulatory framework, deploying strategies to conduct compliant business    
•   Excellent verbal and written business communication, as well as strong organizational, project management, analytical and negotiation skills    
•   Good communication skills and relationship builder with internal and external stakeholders

jobs.occupation: Assistant (all genders) in our EU Representation in Brussels
jobs.description:
• Provide organisational and administrative support to the Brussels team, working closely with the Executive Management Assistant  
• Assist with planning business trips, including travel expense claims  
• Help plan and organise internal and external meetings and events  
• Handle professional correspondence with the member companies, political institutions, public authorities and other stakeholders, and assist with preparing and sending mail merges  
• Manage shared mailboxes and coordinate appointments, deadlines and outstanding tasks  
• Assist with preparing and updating documents, presentations and position papers, including final quality checks  
• Coordinate the monthly eu-flash newsletter and help maintain the website and other information materials  
• Coordinate with internal and external service providers (e.g. IT and suppliers), check invoices and prepare cost summaries  
• Assist with onboarding new employees and interns 
  
• Completed vocational training as a foreign-language secretary or a comparable qualification involving foreign languages, plus several years of experience in an assistant role, ideally in an association, a political institution or a similar environment  
• Professional, courteous communication skills, with the ability to adapt to different audiences  
• Native-level proficiency in German, fluency in English and a good command of French are required  
• Confident and proficient use of MS Office, particularly SharePoint, Teams, PowerPoint and Word  
• Strong organisational and planning skills, with sound judgement in setting priorities, managing deadlines and coordinating multiple tasks  
• An independent, structured approach to work, the ability to work as part of a team, a high level of commitment and dedication, and a strong service orientation

jobs.occupation: Electric Pallet Truck (EPT) Orderpicker / Warehouse Operator - 2 Shifts | Evergem (Ghent region, ...
jobs.description:
As an essential link in our order fulfillment chain, your focus is safety, speed, and accuracy. Every day brings variety:
    
•   
Safely navigate the warehouse floor operating an Electric Pallet Truck (EPT) to pick, stage, and transfer orders.
    
•   
Execute precise loading and unloading procedures, ensuring all materials remain 100% damage-free.
    
•   
Follow structured warehouse safety protocols to stage, stack, and place incoming goods accurately.
    
•   
Support stock counting, inventory tracking, and swift shelf replenishment so goods are always ready to roll.
   

 
    
•   
Proven hands-on experience operating an Electric Pallet Truck (EPT), backed by a valid EPT certificate or license.
    
•   
Full availability and willingness to work in an alternating two-shift schedule (early and late shifts).
    
•   
Strong English communication skills to ensure seamless coordination and safety across the warehouse floor.
    
•   
Reliable personal transport (car, motorbike, or e-bike) to commute independently to the facility in Evergem.
